  "description": "Sylvastar Group is a diversified Nigerian conglomerate with its headquarters in Abuja, Nigeria, operating across multiple sectors including real estate, agriculture, food &amp; beverages, finance, and petrochemical manufacturing.

We are&nbsp;recruiting to fill the position below:

&nbsp;Job Position: Customer Relations Officer

Job Location: Wuse, Abuja (FCT)&nbsp;
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Client Relationship Management:


	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
	Serve as a key point of contact for clients, responding promptly to enquiries, concerns, and requests.
	Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the property buying, selling, or investment process.


Real Estate Client Support:


	Provide clients with accurate information about available properties, locations, prices, payment plans, and investment opportunities.
	Understand clients&rsquo; property needs and recommend suitable properties based on their preferences and budget.
	Assist clients with property viewing arrangements and coordinate with the Sales Team where necessary.


Lead Follow-Up &amp; Conversion:


	Follow up on leads generated through social media, advertisements, referrals, walk-ins, and other marketing channels.
	Maintain consistent communication with prospects to nurture leads and encourage conversion.
	Keep accurate records of client interactions, enquiries, follow-ups, and sales opportunities.


Customer Experience:


	Ensure a smooth and professional customer experience from initial enquiry through to completion of the transaction.
	Handle customer complaints and enquiries professionally and escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or management.
	Follow up with clients after transactions to ensure satisfaction and encourage repeat business and referrals.


Real Estate Knowledge &amp; Advisory Support:


	Maintain good knowledge of the company&rsquo;s properties, developments, locations, selling points, documentation, and payment structures.
	Stay informed about real estate trends, property locations, and market developments within Abuja.
	Provide clients with clear and accurate information without making unauthorized promises or commitments.


Sales &amp; Team Coordination:


	Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to ensure effective lead management and client follow-up.
	Support the Sales Team with client communication, appointments, property information, and transaction updates.
	Provide regular reports on client enquiries, follow-ups, feedback, and conversion opportunities.


Customer Records &amp; Reporting:


	Maintain an updated database of clients and prospects.
	Document customer feedback and identify recurring issues or opportunities for improving customer service.
	Prepare periodic customer relations and follow-up reports as required by management.


Key Requirements


	Previous experience in Customer Relations, Customer Service, Client Management, or a related role within the real estate industry.
	Good knowledge of the Abuja real estate market, including major locations, landmarks, and property investment opportunities.
	Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to manage multiple clients and follow up consistently.
	Good knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar tools is an advantage.
	Professional appearance, confidence, patience, and a strong customer-service mindset.


Method of Application&nbsp;

Customer Relations Officer Job at Sylvastar Group




        
    

        
        Sylvastar Group is a diversified Nigerian conglomerate with its headquarters in Abuja, Nigeria, operating across multiple sectors including real estate, agriculture, food & beverages, finance, and petrochemical manufacturing.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Relations Officer

Job Location: Wuse, Abuja (FCT) 
Employment Type: Full-time

Key Responsibilities
Client Relationship Management:
     

            
    




	Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
	Serve as a key point of contact for clients, responding promptly to enquiries, concerns, and requests.
	Maintain regular communication with clients throughout the property buying, selling, or investment process.


Real Estate Client Support:


	Provide clients with accurate information about available properties, locations, prices, payment plans, and investment opportunities.
	Understand clients’ property needs and recommend suitable properties based on their preferences and budget.
	Assist clients with property viewing arrangements and coordinate with the Sales Team where necessary.


Lead Follow-Up & Conversion:


	Follow up on leads generated through social media, advertisements, referrals, walk-ins, and other marketing channels.
	Maintain consistent communication with prospects to nurture leads and encourage conversion.
	Keep accurate records of client interactions, enquiries, follow-ups, and sales opportunities.


Customer Experience:


	Ensure a smooth and professional customer experience from initial enquiry through to completion of the transaction.
	Handle customer complaints and enquiries professionally and escalate complex issues to the appropriate department or management.
	Follow up with clients after transactions to ensure satisfaction and encourage repeat business and referrals.


Real Estate Knowledge & Advisory Support:


	Maintain good knowledge of the company’s properties, developments, locations, selling points, documentation, and payment structures.
	Stay informed about real estate trends, property locations, and market developments within Abuja.
	Provide clients with clear and accurate information without making unauthorized promises or commitments.


Sales & Team Coordination:


	Work closely with Sales and Marketing teams to ensure effective lead management and client follow-up.
	Support the Sales Team with client communication, appointments, property information, and transaction updates.
	Provide regular reports on client enquiries, follow-ups, feedback, and conversion opportunities.


Customer Records & Reporting:


	Maintain an updated database of clients and prospects.
	Document customer feedback and identify recurring issues or opportunities for improving customer service.
	Prepare periodic customer relations and follow-up reports as required by management.


Key Requirements


	Previous experience in Customer Relations, Customer Service, Client Management, or a related role within the real estate industry.
	Good knowledge of the Abuja real estate market, including major locations, landmarks, and property investment opportunities.
	Strong communication, interpersonal, negotiation, and problem-solving skills.
	Ability to manage multiple clients and follow up consistently.
	Good knowledge of CRM systems, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, or similar tools is an advantage.
	Professional appearance, confidence, patience, and a strong customer-service mindset.


Method of Application 
Interested and qualified candidates should send their CV to: [email protected] using the Job Position as the Subject of the mail;

Customer Service Representative Job at GlobalPay Limited




        
    

        
        GlobalPay Limited is a global payment company that values financial and social inclusion. The company provides innovative payment solutions that break down physical borders, boundaries, and social status to enable everyone to enjoy financial and social inclusion.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Customer Service Representative

Job Location: Lagos 

About the Role
     

            
    




	Global Pay Limited is seeking a personable and solutions-driven Customer Service Representative to join our Customer Success team.
	Based in Lagos, Nigeria, this role is the first point of contact for customers and merchants, ensuring every interaction reflects our commitment to fast, reliable, and secure payment experiences.


Key Responsibilities


	Respond promptly to customer inquiries via phone, email, live chat, and social media channels.
	Resolve transaction disputes, failed payments, and account issues in line with service level agreements.
	Escalate complex technical or compliance-related issues to the appropriate internal teams.
	Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and complaints in the CRM/ticketing system.
	Educate customers and merchants on GlobalPay's products, services, and self-service tools.
	Monitor customer satisfaction metrics and contribute ideas to improve service delivery.
	Support onboarding of new merchants and guide them through account setup and verification.


Qualifications


	OND / HND / Bachelor's Degree in any discipline.
	1-3 years of experience in a customer service or call center role, preferably in banking, fintech, or telecoms.
	Familiarity with the Nigerian payment ecosystem is an advantage.
	Fluency in English; proficiency in a local Nigerian language is a plus.


Required Skills & Technologies:


	Communication: Excellent verbal and written English communication skills
	Tools: CRM and helpdesk platforms (e.g., Zendesk, Freshdesk, HubSpot)
	Problem Solving: Strong active listening and conflict-resolution skills
	Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly learn payment products, POS, and digital banking flows
	Digital Literacy: Comfortable with basic office and messaging tools


Collaboration & Work Practices:


	Work closely with Operations and Settlements teams to resolve transaction issues.
	Coordinate with Compliance on KYC-related customer queries.
	Participate in shift rotations, including weekends where required.
	Contribute to team knowledge base and FAQ documentation.


Why Join GlobalPay?


	Play a central role in shaping compliance for a CBN-licensed payment switch.
	Direct exposure to regulators and industry-defining compliance work.
	Competitive compensation and professional development support.
	A culture that treats compliance as a strategic priority, not an afterthought.

title: Recruitment Officer Job at Coinbox Limited
content:
Coinbox Limited is a multi-dimensional Consulting Firm which provides one - stop total business development and support to our vast clientele of start-ups, Small, Medium, growing and Large Enterprises, Cooperative Societies, Groups and Associations.

We are recruiting to fill the position below:

 Job Position: Recruitment Officer

Job Location: Lagos
Employment Type: Full-Time (Hybrid)

Job Summary
     

            
    




	The Recruitment Officer will support the recruitment team in executing client staffing projects.
	The role involves assisting with job postings, sourcing candidates, screening applications, scheduling interviews and maintaining recruitment records.
	The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized and eager to build a career in human resources and recruitment consulting.


Key Responsibilities


	Assist in developing and posting job adverts across appropriate job boards and social media platforms.

	Assist in preparing candidate profiles and shortlisting reports for client review.
	Follow up with candidates and clients to ensure smooth recruitment processes.
	Handle administrative tasks related to recruitment documentation and reporting.

	Minimum of an HND / B.Sc. in Human Resource Management, Business Administration, or a related field.

N250,000 monthly (gross).

	The Admin &amp; Office Operations Officer will be responsible for providing administrative and operational support while ensuring the smooth, organised, hygienic, and professional functioning of the office.

	Provide administrative and operational support as assigned.

	Provide hands-on support whenever required to maintain office-support standards.
	Support the continuity of essential office-support activities during the absence of another Office Assistant.


Office Administration and Staff Support:


	Coordinate routine administrative and operational activities at the office.
	Attend to staff requests relating to routine office support, supplies, hospitality, and administrative assistance.
	Coordinate routine errands, dispatches, deliveries, and official collections as assigned.
	Receive and direct visitors, deliveries, and service providers appropriately.

	Identify shortages early and submit replenishment requests through the approved process.
	Ensure that supplies are stored appropriately and remain accessible to authorised personnel.
	Monitor wastage, misuse, or unusual consumption and report concerns to the HR &amp; Admin Lead.


Facilities and Maintenance Support:


	Conduct routine checks of the office environment and promptly identify maintenance, safety, plumbing, electrical, air-conditioning, furniture, equipment, or facility-related issues.
	Report identified faults and maintenance requirements to the HR &amp; Admin Assistant.
	Support the coordination and follow-up of approved maintenance activities and service-provider visits.
	Ensure that identified office issues are properly documented and followed up until resolution or escalation.
	Monitor the general condition and presentation of office facilities and report issues that may affect staff productivity, visitor experience, or business operations.


Coordination of Office Support Activities:


	Coordinate daily office-support activities with the existing Office Assistant.
	Ensure that cleaning, restroom checks, hospitality, errands, and other assigned support duties are properly scheduled and completed.
	Support the effective allocation of routine office-support tasks.
	Escalate recurring performance gaps, resource shortages, or operational challenges to the HR &amp; Admin Lead.
	Provide practical support to maintain essential office operations during periods of high workload or staff absence.
	Support administrative and office operations at the office when assigned and operationally required.


Compliance, Safety, and Professional Conduct:


	Comply with the organisation&rsquo;s policies, procedures, health and safety requirements, and instructions.
	Handle cleaning materials and office equipment responsibly and in accordance with safety requirements.
	Maintain professional conduct, appropriate personal hygiene, and a presentable appearance at all times.
	Protect company property, supplies, documents, and confidential information.
	Report incidents, damages, hazards, shortages, and other operational concerns promptly.
	Perform other related duties as may reasonably be assigned by the HR &amp; Admin Lead or Management.


Performance Expectations
The successful candidate will be expected to:


	Maintain consistent cleanliness and hygiene standards at the office.
	Ensure restrooms are checked and adequately replenished throughout the day and before close of business.
	Ensure assigned guest-support requirements are handled promptly and professionally.
	Maintain accurate and timely office-support and consumables records.
	Escalate maintenance, supply, and operational issues promptly.
	Ensure assigned administrative and office-support tasks are completed within agreed timelines.
	Demonstrate reliable attendance, initiative, discretion, and professional conduct.
	Contribute to uninterrupted office operations during staff absences and periods of increased workload.


Minimum Qualifications and Experience


	Minimum of OND, HND, or Bachelor&rsquo;s degree in Business Administration, Office Administration, Management, Hospitality Management, or a related discipline.
	2&ndash;3 years of relevant experience in office administration, office operations, executive support, hospitality, facilities support, or a similar role.
	Previous experience supporting senior management, attending to guests, or coordinating office operations will be an advantage.
	Experience monitoring office supplies, consumables, facilities, or office-support activities will be an advantage.
	Demonstrated willingness and ability to perform hands-on office-support duties, including cleaning and maintaining workplace hygiene.
	Basic proficiency in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Word and Excel.
	Good written and verbal communication skills.
	Strong organisational, time-management, and multitasking abilities.
	Ability to work independently, follow instructions, and take ownership of assigned responsibilities.
	Must be reliable, discreet, service-oriented, and professionally presented.
	Must be willing to work on-site in Ikeja, Lagos.


Core Competencies:


	Administrative and office operations support
	Executive and guest service
	Workplace cleanliness and hygiene
	Organisation and time management
	Attention to detail
	Initiative and problem-solving
	Confidentiality and discretion
	Communication and interpersonal skills
	Reliability and accountability
	Ability to perform both administrative and hands-on operational duties.


Salary
N120,000 &ndash; N150,000 monthly (Depending on experience and suitability).

Method of Application&nbsp;

	Sales target achievement&nbsp;

	Repeat purchase rate&nbsp;
	Product availability and visibility across territories&nbsp;
	Monthly sales growth&nbsp;

	Achieve &ge; 100% of monthly sales target across all product lines&nbsp;&nbsp;
	100% achievement of new customer recruitment target&nbsp;&nbsp;

	Drive team customer profiling,&nbsp;&nbsp;visit and engagement; and achieve sales force KPI via optimized customers touchpoint based on agreed segmentation and visit frequency.&nbsp;

	Visit / day&nbsp;
	# of profiled customers.

	10 visits/day&nbsp;
	100% completion of all customers profiling survey questions&nbsp;
